note: Ideal-switch commutation with lumped L_loop and C_oss: HS turn-off rings L_loop with C_oss (estimate I*sqrt(L/C)); HS turn-on applies a voltage step to the L_loop/C_oss(LS) tank, which undamped would overshoot by Vin. Real di/dt, diode capacitance, package and gate-loop parasitics are not modelled. Use as an order-of-magnitude indicator only.
interpretation: The behavioural switch commutates in about one solver step, so the deck's overshoot is the energy-transfer bound of an instantaneous commutation damped only by R_loop; it is NOT a prediction of the C4MS025120K turn-off overshoot. The engineering estimate is L_loop x di/dt at the gate-driver design edge (2.5 A/ns) - see analytic_L_didt - to be replaced by double-pulse measurement.
